build_fx_graph_symbolic_trace: build an FX GraphModule by symbolically tracing a PyTorch nn.Module or Python callable into a executable graph representation
create_tracer_subclass: create a Tracer subclass to override tracing behavior such as is_leaf_module, call_module, or create_args_for_root
wrap_leaf_function: wrap a Python function as a leaf function so torch.fx preserves it as a CallFunction node instead of tracing through its body
define_proxyable_class: define a custom Python class with ProxyableClassMeta metaclass to make its construction symbolically traceable in FX
specialize_concrete_args: specialize function inputs using concrete_args with PH placeholders to eliminate control flow and flatten pytree arguments during tracing
